intent: Technical Brief: System State Baseline for MSI Bravo 15 Gaming
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling and Random System Crashes (BSOD) during gaming sessions.
suggested_solution: Ensure proper cooling system and adequate airflow around the laptop.
Update drivers and BIOS to the latest versions.
Run a virus scan and malware removal tool to ensure the system is free from any malicious software.
Consider purchasing a laptop with a more efficient cooling system, such as dual fans or liquid cooling.
Invest in a high-quality power supply unit (PSU) to provide stable power to the system.
